description: Validation rules for project manifests (project.manifest.json, project-manifest@1). The single source for every validator: framework/core/project.ts (reference), framework/cli/project.mjs (build engine, console API), ai.amberx.axf.kernel.project (Android) and the template build guards. Managed in the Dev Console under Standards. Locked rules are always errors; other rules can be set to error, warn or off, and new rules can be added with any listed op.

ops.pattern: value is a string matching check.pattern
ops.notIn: value is not one of check.values
ops.string: value is a string whose trimmed length is between check.min and check.max
ops.oneOf: value is one of vocab[check.vocab] (or check.values)
ops.eachOneOf: value is an array and every item is one of vocab[check.vocab] (or check.values)
ops.relativePaths: value is an array of project-relative paths (no leading /, no .., no backslashes; folders end with /)
ops.pathsExist: every path in value (a string or an array) exists in the project; skipped when the validator has no file access
ops.requiredWhen: value is present whenever check.when.path equals check.when.equals
ops.knownKeys: the manifest has no top-level keys outside knownKeys (put extensions under "x")

rules.title: Manifest format
rules.description: The file says which format it is: "$manifest": "project-manifest@1".

rules.title: Project name
rules.description: Lowercase letters, digits and dashes, starting with a letter or digit, up to 63 characters. It is the project's folder on the hub (/projects/<name>), so it never changes lightly.

rules.title: Reserved names
rules.description: "shared" stands for /projects/_shared on the hub and can't name a project.

rules.title: Display name
rules.description: A human name, 1 to 80 characters.

rules.title: Kind
rules.description: What the project is: one of the kind vocabulary.

rules.title: Status
rules.description: active, planned, dormant or archived (active when left out).

rules.title: Relation to AmberX AXF
rules.description: framework.relation: core (the framework itself), built-on (an AXF app or library), for (made to work with AXF) or none.

rules.title: Repo owner
rules.description: repo.owner: the GitHub (or other host) account, e.g. MossesX.

rules.title: Repo name
rules.description: repo.name: the project's own repository name. Required even when the repo doesn't exist yet, so it can be created with that name later.

rules.title: Repo exists?
rules.description: repo.exists: true when the repository has been created, false when it is only reserved for the future.

rules.title: Repo host
rules.description: repo.host: github, gitlab, bitbucket or other (github when left out).

rules.title: Repo visibility
rules.description: repo.visibility: private, public or internal.

rules.title: Repo URL
rules.description: repo.url, when given, is an https address.

rules.title: Where the code lives
rules.description: When the project has no repo of its own yet, location says where its code is now (location.repo + location.path).

rules.title: Version
rules.description: version, when given, is semver (1.2.3, optionally -pre).

rules.title: Platforms
rules.description: platforms lists where it runs, from the platform vocabulary.

rules.title: Created date
rules.description: created, when given, is a date: YYYY-MM-DD.

rules.title: Shared data paths
rules.description: data.shared lists the project's shared data as paths inside the project (folders end with /). They sync with /projects/<name>/_data/<same path>.

rules.title: Shared data exists
rules.description: Every data.shared path exists in the project.

rules.title: App manifest
rules.description: framework.appManifest, when given, points at the app's axf.manifest.json.

rules.title: Known fields only
rules.description: No top-level fields outside the known list; extensions go under "x".
